short_bio: Human-rights barrister at Doughty Street Chambers.
biography:
Amal Clooney was born in Beirut and raised in England. She studied at St Hugh’s College, Oxford, and took a law degree at New York University School of Law, and she practises as a barrister at Doughty Street Chambers in London.

Her clients have included Nadia Murad, the Yazidi survivor of Islamic State captivity, former Maldives president Mohamed Nasheed and Julian Assange. She has practised at the International Court of Justice and in 2015 joined the legal team representing Armenia before the European Court of Human Rights in its case against Doğu Perinçek.

In 2012 she served as an adviser to Kofi Annan, then the UN–Arab League envoy on Syria. She married the actor George Clooney in 2014.
